mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE status = 0 -- 待确认
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE status IN (4, 1,2,3) -- 已通过、已拒绝.已完成
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE reserve_date = #{today} AND status IN (4,0,2,3) -- 已通过

SELECT r.room_name as roomName, r.start_time as startTime, r.reserve_date as reserveDate, r.purpose, r.username, r.status, CASE r.status WHEN 0 THEN '待确认' WHEN 1 THEN '已拒绝' WHEN 2 THEN '已过期' WHEN 3 THEN '使用中' WHEN 4 THEN '已通过' ELSE '未知状态' END as statusDesc FROM reservations r WHERE r.reserve_date = #{today} ORDER BY r.start_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE reserve_date = #{today} AND status = 0 -- 待确认
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE DATE(approve_time) = CURDATE() AND approver_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN (1, 4,2,3) -- 已批准(4)或已拒绝(1)都算已审批

SELECT r.room_id, COUNT(r.reservation_id) as usage_count FROM reservations r WHERE r.reserve_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.status IN (2,3,4)
AND r.room_id IN
#{roomId}
GROUP BY r.room_id

SELECT room_id, COUNT(reservation_id) as usage_count FROM reservations WHERE reserve_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{currentWeekStart}, INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(#{currentWeekEnd}, INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND status IN (4,3,2)
AND room_id IN
#{roomId}
GROUP BY room_id

SELECT CASE WHEN #{period} = 'week' THEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) WHEN #{period} = 'month' THEN DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') WHEN #{period} = 'quarter' THEN MAKEDATE(YEAR(CURDATE()), 1) + INTERVAL (QUARTER(CURDATE())-1)*3 MONTH - INTERVAL 1 DAY WHEN #{period} = 'year' THEN DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-01-01') ELSE DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) END as start_date, CASE WHEN #{period} = 'week' THEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE())-6 DAY) WHEN #{period} = 'month' THEN LAST_DAY(CURDATE()) WHEN #{period} = 'quarter' THEN MAKEDATE(YEAR(CURDATE()), 1) + INTERVAL QUARTER(CURDATE())*3 MONTH - INTERVAL 1 DAY WHEN #{period} = 'year' THEN DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-12-31') ELSE DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE())-6 DAY) END as end_date
